description: Set camera layer options (Layer > Camera Settings, and Camera Options in the Timeline): zoom, F-Stop, depth of field, focus distance, aperture, blur level, iris shape, rotation, roundness, aspect ratio and diffraction fringe, highlight gain, threshold and saturation, and Point of Interest. Values are keyframed when the property is animated or a time is given

aperture.description: Aperture in pixels; larger blurs more

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

depthOfField.description: Depth of Field on or off; the Advanced 3D renderer renders it in-engine

fStop.description: F-Stop (Camera Settings): sets Aperture to Zoom divided by the F-Stop. Not with aperture

layers.description: Which camera layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

pointOfInterest.description: Point of Interest [x, y, z] in pixels, for two-node cameras and lights

time.description: Seconds: set keyframes at this time. Omit to set the static value, or a keyframe at the current time when the property is already animated

zoom.description: Zoom: pixels from the camera to the image plane (sets the angle of view and focal length)

name: set_camera_options
title: Set Camera Options
